routes.name: Harbour Spin
routes.description: A flat lap of Port Anchor: the promenade, Lighthouse Rise, the old town and back along the seafront. Warm-ups, recovery and first rides.

routes.name: Lagoon Lap
routes.description: Out over the causeway to the tidal lagoon and the turbine loop, with a sprint between the reed beds.

routes.name: Downs Rollers
routes.description: Up the Greenfold Ramp into orchard country, over the rollers and the Stone Circle climb, then a fast run back to the harbour.

routes.name: Cobble Crown
routes.description: Along the east coast, up the cobbled ramps of Stonebridge, over the clock-tower ridge and back through the downs.

routes.name: Tea Trail
routes.description: A steady seven-kilometre climb through misty tea terraces, then a sweeping descent past the waterfalls to the lagoon.

routes.name: Solace Summit
routes.description: The big one: from the valley floor to the summit observatory, thirteen and a half kilometres of hairpins.

routes.name: Forest Ribbon
routes.description: Into the giant trees through Fern Gorge and round the Canopy Loop under the footbridge.

routes.name: Fjord Run
routes.description: Along the cold-lit fjord shore, then six kilometres up to the viewpoint above the suspension bridge.

routes.name: Red Mesa
routes.description: Long false flats across the red desert, a gravel sector, then the mesa climb under the natural arch.

routes.name: Cinder Rim
routes.description: Out over the causeway to the volcanic island and once round the crater rim above the lake.

routes.name: Three Peaks
routes.description: Tea terraces, Mount Solace and the high fjord road in one big day.

routes.name: Grand Tour of Velora
routes.description: Every region in one ride: Cinder Isle, Stonebridge, the fjord, the summit, the downs, the tea hills, the rainforest, the canyon and the lagoon, back to the pier.
